items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: And I got up and blow it and especially that tramo player, he's crazy about me. Baby, what's his name, Baby?

ctx.x: And when did Celestan pick up on you?

Well Celestan picked up on me one night. I went to Italian Hall on Esplanade Street. Well I wasn't playing that night and I just went there and I wanted to blow something. He had never seen me. And I played a little bit and he asked me who I was working with. I told him well I just wasn't working with nobody at that particular time. So he said well come to the high school. And I went to the high school. And he played a lot of old time stuff. Well I played you know I played the second trumpet right behind him. And…
I know who you mean. He's an old man now, lives uptown. Yeah, yeah. Up around Calton. On Edinburgh he used to live. Is that the guy Baby Ridgely? Baby Ridgely, yeah.
